hook.h2: He had this edition's reader in mind
hook.text: Even to your old age I am he, and to your gray hairs I will carry you. I made you, and I will bear you; I will carry you and I will rescue you.
father: Even to your old age I am he, and to your gray hairs I will carry you. I made you, and I will bear you; I will carry you and I will rescue you.
hook.note: Every word of that verse is our Father speaking, so on the page you are holding it is blue from end to end — and it is Him saying it, about the exact season this edition was set for. That is the difference the color makes, and it is the reason the type being readable matters.

short350: You have wanted a Father your whole life. Not a doctrine about Him. Not a distant power. A Father — His voice, His heart turned toward you.
Father's Heart Bible is the first Bible in print where you can see who is speaking.
Our Father's words in BLUE. The Son's in RED. The Spirit's in PURPLE.

For a hundred and twenty-five years, red letters have shown the Son speaking. Our Father speaks more than three times as often — 125,457 words across 5,623 verses — and every one of them has been printed in the same black ink as the genealogies. More than one word in four of the Bible is a divine person speaking. The color marks ownership, not quotation: His words stay His on any lips that carry them faithfully, words He never spoke are never colored, and narration stays black.
When His own asked how to pray, the Son did not give them a formula. He gave them a Father, and told them to say so out loud. Everything in this Bible follows from that one word.
That is what this Bible was made to do. Not to tell you about a Father who speaks, but to show you where He already has.

He is not distant. He is not disappointed. He is your Heavenly Father, and He delights in you as His beloved child. If father is not a word of comfort for you, this Bible is especially for you: the Father revealed here is no projection of broken human fatherhood, but the original, from whom every family in heaven and on earth takes its name.

An introduction opens each book, a Father's note closes each with a short prayer, and 587 notes serve the reader, not the scholar. A presentation page carries their name. Six by nine, paperback and hardcover, full color throughout.

A fresh translation from the original Hebrew, Aramaic, and Greek. This large print edition sets Genesis, Psalms, Proverbs and the entire New Testament in full text — 30 books, 491 chapters, 12,851 verses — and gives each of the remaining 36 Old Testament books an introduction with selected passages. A gift, a keepsake, an heirloom.
Receive the Father. Hear His voice. His heart is for you.

long.h: A Three Color Bible: Red Letter, Blue Letter, Purple Letter
body: The color is a mark of ownership, not of quotation. His words stay His on any lips that carry them faithfully, and words He never spoke are never colored. Our Father speaks 125,457 words here. The Son speaks 39,936. More than one word in four of this Bible is a divine person speaking.

God is our Father. Not a role He plays. Father is who He is, and Father is His name, the name Jesus came to reveal: "I revealed your name to those you gave me from the world" (John 17:6). This translation lets the Hebrew and Greek speak the distinction they always made: God as Father, Abba Father, your Heavenly Father — and you, His beloved child.

If the word father is not a word of comfort for you, this Bible is especially for you. The Father revealed here is no projection of broken human fatherhood. He is the original, from whom every family in heaven and on earth takes its name.

faq.a: It is set larger throughout than the regular 6 x 9 edition. Rather than take our word for it, open Look inside above — the sample pages are rendered from the actual print file, so what you see is the type you will hold.

Not in full text, and we would rather you knew that before you buy. This edition sets Genesis, Psalms, Proverbs and the entire New Testament in full — 30 books, 491 chapters, 12,851 verses. The remaining 36 Old Testament books are given as an introduction with selected passages rather than the whole text. That is the trade large print makes: at this type size the complete text would not be one book. If you want every verse in full, choose the regular Father's Heart Bible, which is complete at 66 books and 31,085 verses.
Word for word, yes, wherever the text appears in full. Same fresh translation from the original Hebrew, Aramaic and Greek, the same 170 translation rules, and the same Divine Voice Color throughout.

faq.q: How many study notes does it carry?
faq.a: 587, alongside an introduction to every one of the 66 books and a Father's note closing each with a short prayer. The regular edition carries 1,354.

faq.q: Is it a good gift for a parent or grandparent?
faq.a: It is the most common reason people buy it. There is a presentation page inside the front for a name and a date, and the hardback is built for years of daily handling. Charcoal and Plum are the usual choices for a gift.
